tools.name: search_products
tools.description:
Products matching a name, GTIN or SKU: verified outcome summary, plus price, availability, rating and return
    policy as published on the merchant's site (labelled not verified).

tools.name: get_product_outcomes
tools.description: Score, sample size, outcome breakdown and top return reasons for one product.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Outcomes for 2 to 5 products, in the order given.

tools.name: get_merchant_profile
tools.description: Return rate, complaint rate and delivery issue rate across a merchant's products.

tools.name: submit_outcome
tools.description: Record a purchase outcome for a product (product_id or product_url). Requires an API key (Authorization: Bearer header). Proofs: shopify_order (shop domain, order number, confirmation number) is checked against the shop's order record; email_receipt (the merchant's original DKIM-signed confirmation

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_outcome" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_merchant_profile · Private data: submit_outcome · Public sink: submit_outcome.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_merchant_profile · Private data: submit_outcome · Public sink: submit_outcome

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
